canonical_name: Riemann-Roch theorem for compact Riemann surfaces (exact analytic variant open)
literal_source_claim_en: Divisor theory of compact Riemann surfaces.
statement_blocker: The catalog supplies a topic-level gloss rather than a formula and no source edition. The statement phase must fix the compact connected Riemann-surface convention; divisor, degree, meromorphic-function order and L(D) definitions; genus; canonical divisor or bundle; integer coercions; ordered binders; conclusion form; and boundary cases. It must also preserve the boundary from separately cataloged algebraic-curve targets THM-M-0105 and THM-M-0175. Selecting the familiar formula without an approved source mapping would invent these proposition-changing choices.
domain_and_universes: Prospective compact connected complex one-manifold X, finite integral divisors on X, meromorphic functions or divisor-line-bundle sections, a canonical divisor or canonical bundle, and natural/integer dimensions and degrees. Exact universes, topology/manifold instances, connectedness convention, and object representations remain open.
conclusion: Prospective family only: for each divisor D on the selected compact Riemann surface, ell(D) - ell(K - D) = deg(D) + 1 - g. The source-selected formula, definitions, binder order, coercions, and any existence or choice-independence clauses remain open.
candidate_statement_shape_not_credited: Let X be a compact connected Riemann surface of genus g, D a divisor, K a canonical divisor, and ell(E) the complex dimension of the meromorphic functions f with (f) + E effective (including zero). Then ell(D) - ell(K-D) = deg(D) + 1 - g.
